title: SQL Mission 6: Latest 3 Orders Per Customer

initialState.content:
-- Dashboard needs each customer's 3 most recent orders.
-- Use ROW_NUMBER to rank orders per customer.
--
-- Rules:
--   1. Partition by customer_id
--   2. Order by order_date DESC (newest = 1)
--   3. Keep only rn <= 3
--
-- Table: orders(order_id, customer_id, order_date, status, total_amount)

WITH ranked_orders AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    order_id,
    order_date,
    -- TODO: ROW_NUMBER() window function
  FROM orders
)
SELECT
  customer_id,
  order_id,
  order_date
FROM ranked_orders
WHERE
  -- TODO: keep only top 3 per customer
ORDER BY customer_id, order_date DESC;

rules: must_include:row_number() over (partition by customer_id order by order_date desc) as rn
